# CameraNetworks

Keeps faction bodycam networks private. The TSF, PDV and MMC long-range wireless routers reach cameras across the
sector, and they used to answer every wireless camera monitor too, so any TV or console could watch a faction's
bodycams. A router with `WFLocalCameraRouter` only answers monitors on its own grid; bodycams still connect from
anywhere in range.
